description:
## What
Implement the per-certificate NameConstraints state update in chain_walk per RFC 5280 §6.1.4(b).

## Algorithm
After processing each intermediate CA cert (not the EE):
1. Extract NC from this cert via cert_name_constraints()
2. If Some(nc):
   a. permittedSubtrees: INTERSECT current permitted_subtrees with nc.permitted_subtrees
      - If permitted_subtrees is None (unconstrained), set to nc.permitted_subtrees
      - If nc.permitted_subtrees is None, keep current (no further restriction)
      - If both Some: keep only subtrees present in both (variant-by-variant intersection)
   b. excludedSubtrees: UNION current excluded_subtrees with nc.excluded_subtrees
      - Append nc.excluded_subtrees entries to excluded_subtrees

## Defensive programming
- Treat missing permittedSubtrees in NC as "no additional restriction on permitted"
- Treat missing excludedSubtrees in NC as "no additional exclusions"
- Self-issued intermediate CAs: skip NC state update (RFC 5280 §6.1.4(b) exception)
  Self-issued = issuer DN == subject DN (use existing name_matches())

## Acceptance criteria
- After processing a CA with permittedSubtrees=[.example.com], permitted_subtrees reflects that restriction
- After processing a CA with excludedSubtrees=[.evil.com], .evil.com is in excluded_subtrees
- Self-issued intermediate: state not updated
- Depends on: PKIX-xlp (cert_name_constraints), PKIX-cg1 (state vars)
title: Implement NC state update (INTERSECTION/UNION)
